nights.title: Emir Can İğrek
nights.name: Emir Can İğrek
nights.extract: Emir Can İğrek is a Turkish singer and songwriter. He started making music by setting up small stage groups in the city where he was born. In 2019, he had his breakthrough with the song "Nalan". At the 2020 PowerTürk Music Awards, he was awarded as the "Most Powerful Newcomer of the Year". He has also composed songs for artists such as Funda Arar and Ferhat Göçer.

nights.name: Gökhan Türkmen
nights.extract: Gökhan Türkmen is a Turkish singer.

nights.title: Levent Yüksel
nights.name: Levent Yüksel
nights.extract: Levent Uğur Yüksel is a Turkish pop singer and multi instrumentalist. He has been active in live music industry since 1993.

nights.title: Ersay Üner
nights.name: Ersay Üner
nights.extract: Ersay Üner, is a Turkish pop music singer-songwriter. He became known in Turkey in 2000s by writing and composing songs for Demet Akalın.

nights.title: Yalın - Bir Büyülü Gece
nights.name: Yalın
nights.extract: Hüseyin Yalın, better known by his surname Yalın, is a Turkish pop singer and songwriter. He achieved success with the song "Zalim" in 2004.

nights.title: Soner Sarıkabadayı
nights.name: Soner Sarıkabadayı
nights.extract: Soner Sarıkabadayı is a Turkish pop music singer and songwriter.

nights.title: Ebru Yaşar
nights.name: Ebru Yaşar
nights.extract: Ebru Yaşar is a Turkish pop music singer.
